title: Alert Digest Trimming
source: 80. Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array II
brief: Our on-call digest lists incident codes sorted in ascending order. Pages for the same code get noisy, so the digest keeps at most two entries per code, and the trimming runs inside the existing array to avoid extra allocations.
Implement capRepeatsAtTwo(nums), where nums holds the sorted incident codes. Rearrange nums in place so its first k slots keep each code at most twice, in the original ascending order, and return k.
